A mini world change in which a large {wiki:Chakoya Iceberg|iceberg} runs aground on the north coast of {wiki:Tiquanda}, north of Port Hope, bringing with it a tribe of {wiki:Chakoyas}. It gives no reward of its own, but it is a good place to hunt Chakoyas and collect {item:Fireproof Horn|Fireproof Horns}, and it is one of the locations of the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}.
An iceberg has suddenly appeared in the north of Tiquanda.
The mini world change has to be active on your server that day.
Nothing special: bring potions and a weapon for the Chakoyas.
No rewards of its own. You can loot {item:Fireproof Horn|Fireproof Horns} from the Chakoyas.
If you are doing the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}, take advantage of the days when the iceberg is active: it is one of that quest's locations.
1. Find out whether the iceberg is active

This mini world change is not always active. When it happens, messages like these appear in the game:
- *"A big iceberg has been washed up at the coast north of Port Hope. It seems to be inhabited by strange white furballs."*
- *"A floating vessel of ice is not at all nice when it brings unbidden friends to Port Hope's lands."*

If you are not in **Port Hope** yet, take a boat there (for example in Thais, Venore, Ankrahmun or Liberty Bay): talk to the captain and say {key:hi}, {key:port hope} and {key:yes}. You arrive at the Port Hope harbour, next to {npc:Charles}.
Get to the iceberg (north of Tiquanda)

Leave **Port Hope** on foot and walk **north**, through the **northwest of Tiquanda**, to the coast where the iceberg ran aground ({coord:32624,32586,7}). You do not need a boat or a rope: the iceberg is only reachable by land while the mini world change is active. On the way you may meet {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}, {creature:Slime|Slimes} and {creature:Terror Bird|Terror Birds}.

The iceberg is inhabited by {creature:Chakoya Toolshaper|Chakoya Toolshapers}, {creature:Chakoya Tribewarden|Chakoya Tribewardens} and {creature:Chakoya Windcaller|Chakoya Windcallers}. Hunt them to collect {item:Fireproof Horn|Fireproof Horns}.
To leave, go back the same way: leave the iceberg for the Tiquanda coast and walk **south** to **Port Hope**. There you can take {npc:Charles}'s boat at the harbour to go back to another city.
